sections.title: Do this first
paragraphs: Start a Gemini chat. Choose the image tool. Ask for a cream sign with a blue anchor on its left and a gold bell on its right. Inspect the layout by eye. If video is offered, request a slow pan from anchor to bell.
Look for the anchor on the left and the bell on the right. If they are swapped, request that one correction.
